command:
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$workspace = 'D:\GitHub\Forge-Conductor-Windows-Edition'
$priorRecordRelative = '.forge-codex\state\commands\20260827T100751448Z-8deaa7ec.json'
$priorRecordPath = Join-Path $workspace $priorRecordRelative
$prior = Get-Content -Raw -LiteralPath $priorRecordPath | ConvertFrom-Json
if ($prior.exit_code -ne 1 -or $prior.timed_out) { throw 'Unexpected prior command disposition.' }
function Get-LowerSha256([string]$path) { return (Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 -LiteralPath $path).Hash.ToLowerInvariant() }
$stdoutPath = Join-Path $workspace $prior.stdout
$stderrPath = Join-Path $workspace $prior.stderr
if ((Get-LowerSha256 $stdoutPath) -ne $prior.stdout_sha256 -or (Get-LowerSha256 $stderrPath) -ne $prior.stderr_sha256) { throw 'Prior command stream hash mismatch.' }
$stdout = Get-Content -Raw -LiteralPath $stdoutPath
$stderr = Get-Content -Raw -LiteralPath $stderrPath
$requiredPassLines = @(
  'MCP tool-pack adapter tests passed: 470 assertions',
  'MCP tool contract matrix passed 1737 assertions across 53 tools and 212 cases.',
  '5/5 native filesystem/search tests passed.',
  '100% tests passed out of 3',
  'Total Test time (real) =  13.25 sec'
)
foreach ($line in $requiredPassLines) { if (-not $stdout.Contains($line)) { throw "Missing prior pass evidence: $line" } }
if (-not $stderr.Contains("A parameter cannot be found that matches parameter name 'Depth'.") -or -not $stderr.Contains('ConvertFrom-Json')) { throw 'Prior post-test failure is not the qualified PowerShell 5.1 incompatibility.' }
$sourceFiles = @(
  'CMakeLists.txt',
  'include\ForgeConductor\Mcp\McpToolPackAdapter.h',
  'src\Hosts\Cli\McpServeCompositionRoot.cpp',
  'src\Mcp\McpToolPackAdapter.cpp',
  'src\NativeTools\Windows\WindowsPathGlobService.cpp',
  'tests\Mcp\McpToolPackAdapterTests.cpp',
  'tests\NativeTools\WindowsFileSystemSearchTests.cpp',
  'tests\Mcp\McpToolContractMatrixTests.cpp',
  'tests\Mcp\McpToolContractTestSupport.cpp',
  'tests\Mcp\McpToolContractTestSupport.h',
  'tests\fixtures\Mcp\mcp-tool-contract-cases.json'
)
$priorStart = [DateTimeOffset]::Parse([string]$prior.start_utc).UtcDateTime
foreach ($sourceFile in $sourceFiles) {
  $absolute = Join-Path $workspace $sourceFile
  $item = Get-Item -LiteralPath $absolute
  if ($item.LastWriteTimeUtc -gt $priorStart) { throw "Build input changed after recorded build started: $sourceFile" }
  Write-Output ("SOURCE path={0} bytes={1} sha256={2}" -f $sourceFile,$item.Length,(Get-LowerSha256 $absolute))
}
$fixture = Get-Content -Raw -LiteralPath (Join-Path $workspace 'tests\fixtures\Mcp\mcp-tool-contract-cases.json') | ConvertFrom-Json
$names = @($fixture.tools | ForEach-Object name)
$caseCount = ($fixture.tools | ForEach-Object { $_.cases.psobject.Properties.Count } | Measure-Object -Sum).Sum
$categoryFailures = @($fixture.tools | Where-Object { (@($_.cases.psobject.Properties.Name | Sort-Object) -join ',') -ne 'boundary,dependency_error,invalid,valid' })
if ($fixture.tools.Count -ne 53 -or @($names | Sort-Object -Unique).Count -ne 53 -or $caseCount -ne 212 -or $categoryFailures.Count -ne 0) { throw 'MCP fixture inventory mismatch.' }
Write-Output 'MCP_FIXTURE tools=53 unique=53 cases=212 categories=valid,invalid,dependency_error,boundary'
$artifacts = @(
  'out\build\windows-msvc-x64\bin\Debug\ForgeConductor.Mcp.ToolContractMatrixTests.exe',
  'out\build\windows-msvc-x64\bin\Debug\ForgeConductor.Mcp.ToolPackAdapterTests.exe',
  'out\build\windows-msvc-x64\bin\Debug\ForgeConductor.NativeTools.FileSystemSearchTests.exe',
  'out\build\windows-msvc-x64\lib\Debug\ForgeConductor.Mcp.lib',
  'out\build\windows-msvc-x64\lib\Debug\ForgeConductor.NativeTools.Windows.lib'
)
foreach ($artifact in $artifacts) {
  $absolute = Join-Path $workspace $artifact
  $item = Get-Item -LiteralPath $absolute
  Write-Output ("ARTIFACT path={0} bytes={1} sha256={2}" -f $artifact,$item.Length,(Get-LowerSha256 $absolute))
}
Write-Output "RECOVERED_BUILD_TEST_RECORD record=$priorRecordRelative stdout_sha256=$($prior.stdout_sha256) stderr_sha256=$($prior.stderr_sha256)"
